simple.summary: צְרֵרָה (Tsᵉrêrâh) means Tsererah for Tseredah First listed occurrence: Judg 7 22.

definitions.full: H6888. Tsererah [ צְרֵרָה ] proper name, of a location צְרֵרָ֫תָה Judg 7:22 ( Γαραγαθα , ᵐ5 . of L καὶ ἦν συνηγμένη ), usually thought corrupt for צְרֵדָ֫תָה , and in nay case probably = צָֽרְתָן , q. v. (GFM).
